title: Expected Time Bound from Eventual Halting
statement: Let $r$ map Boolean lists to optional values and suppose it is prefix-stable: once it returns a value on a list, it returns that same value on every extension. If there is a natural number $t_0$ such that $r(w)$ is not none for every Boolean list $w$ of length $t_0$, then for every natural number $K$, the sum of the probabilities that $r$ has not halted by time $t$, over all $t<K$, is at most $t_0$.
